name: Número de Registre Tributari (NRT)
issuer: the Andorran administration (the NIA's register; the sheet names no office)
note: Andorra's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: taxable subjects must obtain and use a Tax Register Number (NRT) under Law 21/2014; for residents it is the Administrative Identification Number (NIA, Law 8/2007) preceded by F, and it is issued automatically when the NIA is obtained (article 14 of the tax management Regulations of 11 February 2015): F, six digits (0 to 699,999) and a control letter (rule not given, `check` left out). The sheet doesn't name the office that gives the NIA. Read as given on registration, to residents. No fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Andorra: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: For natural persons resident in Andorra, the NRT is the Número d’Identificació Administrativa (Administrative Identification Number, NIA), preceded by the letter “F” ... F + 6 digits + 1 control letter TIN number for individuals is issued automatically when they obtain the Administrative Identification Number (NIA)
